name: Delphi
note: Borland's Object Pascal dialect for rapid application development
typeSystem: Static, strong, nominal (Object Pascal): classes, interfaces, and generics, enforced at compile time much like Pascal, extended for large-scale application and component-based (VCL) development.
runtime: Compiled ahead-of-time to native machine code for Windows, macOS, iOS, Android, and Linux. Since Delphi 10.4, general class objects use the classic explicit lifetime model on all targets; strings, dynamic arrays, and interface references retain automatic management or reference-counting behavior.

runtimes.name: Native (Delphi compiler)
runtimes.role: AOT compiles Object Pascal to native machine code across desktop and mobile targets.

compilers.name: Delphi (dcc32/dcc64)
compilers.role: Embarcadero's official compiler, the primary Object Pascal/Delphi toolchain.

compilers.name: Free Pascal
compilers.role: Open-source compiler offering a Delphi-compatible mode.

concurrencyModel: OS threads (TThread) plus higher-level tasks and futures added in later RTL versions.
